title: The warm thread remembers
optical_mapping: Designed faceted pale amber carrier. Native deposit isosurfaces at .99, .65 and .11 become a copper-gold heart, transparent mineral gel and thin-film transparent sheath. Absolute saved pressure / measured maximum, thresholded at .08 and gated by native mineral*6, drives cyan emission; this is a chosen display, not physical luminescence. Native pressure sampled at mineral vertices, normalized by maximum pressure within deposit>.11, also tints the core toward cyan and drives emission3× normalized amplitude above.12. No displacement or procedural interior geometry.
